purpose: Warmed CPU latency of the float32 binary_galactica.single.ucb_waveform (x64 disabled) against the float64 on-fly ucb_waveform (x64 enabled) on identical sources.

method.processes: one process per precision and round; the order alternates each round; JAX_ENABLE_X64 is removed from each worker's environment
method.clock: time.perf_counter_ns around one call, stopped after every output leaf blocks; the first call and the warmups are excluded
method.public: ordinary public call on host NumPy inputs, with validation
method.jit: outer jax.jit, compiled ahead of time with lower().compile(); device inputs, T and t0 dynamic, q_ref a dynamic int32 scalar
method.batch: jax.jit(jax.vmap(...)) over params and q_ref, compiled ahead of time; T and t0 shared
method.inputs: split_native of a seeded catalogue near 3 mHz; float64 receives the exact float64 values of the float32 inputs
method.summary: median over rounds of each round's median latency
method.load: os.getloadavg() at each worker's start and end, per round
